app.tagline: Blur all of an image or just the parts you paint. Image files never leave your device.
app.dropOverlay: Drop the image to open it

input.hint: or drop it anywhere, or paste it with Ctrl+V
input.linkNotice: Links are fetched through our server. Files you open, drop or paste never leave your browser.

effects.warning: Blur and pixelate don't reliably hide text. For anything secret, cover it with a solid box in another editor, or leave it out.

export.hint: Original resolution. No metadata, no watermark.

notice.downscaled: This image is {width} × {height} px, larger than your graphics card can handle ({max} px per side). It was scaled down to {scaledWidth} × {scaledHeight} px, and the download will be that size.

errors.decode_failed: This file isn't an image your browser can open.
errors.invalid_link: Enter an http or https link to an image.
errors.webgl_unavailable: Your browser couldn't start WebGL, which this app needs to render effects.
errors.webgl_context_lost: Your browser interrupted WebGL, which this app needs to render effects. Your edits are kept and come back when WebGL does. If nothing changes, reload the page and open the image again.
errors.load_failed: The image couldn't be loaded from that link.
errors.invalid_url: That link isn't a valid web address.
errors.forbidden_origin: This site isn't allowed to load images through the proxy.
errors.unsupported_protocol: Only http and https links can be loaded.
errors.unsupported_port: Only links on standard web ports can be loaded.
errors.blocked_address: That link points to a private or local address, which can't be loaded.
errors.upstream_status: The site didn't return the image. Check that the link opens in your browser.
errors.not_an_image: That link doesn't point to an image.
errors.too_large: That image is too large to load by link. Download it and open the file instead.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests from your network right now. Try again in about a minute.
errors.download_interrupted: The download was interrupted. If the image is large, download it and open the file instead.
errors.timeout: The site took too long to respond.
errors.too_many_redirects: The link redirects too many times.
errors.credentials_not_allowed: Links that contain a username or password can't be loaded.
errors.not_found: The image service couldn't be found. Try again later.
errors.internal_error: The image service ran into a problem. Try again later.

canvas.label: Image. Paint on it with the pointer. Shortcuts while it has focus: B brush, E eraser, [ and ] brush size.
